+title: 'SK-6b: SkillWriter writes, edits and removes a skill in the user or project layer'
+---
+## What
+Part of SK-6 (D87 (d), D175). Add the file logic of the three writes, with no tool code. Create `Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Registry/SkillWriter.swift`:
+- `public enum SkillWriteLayer: String, CaseIterable, Sendable { case user, project }`. The default is `.user` (D175). Keep the name `layer` and the values `user` and `project` the same as the `agents` tool (AG-9, FoundationModelsAgents).
+- The target root: the highest-precedence layer of `SkillsRegistry`'s layers with `DotfolderStack.Source` `.user` or `.project`. In the app the user layer is `<iCloud container>/Documents/Agents/_skills/` and the project layer is `<cwd>/.skills/`. The host gives these roots through the `DotfolderStack`. The writer does not compute them. The registry must keep its layers (today it keeps only `roots: [URL]`), thus add `layers` to `SkillsRegistry` or give the writer the stack.
+- `add(name:skillMarkdown:layer:)`: makes `<root>/<name>/SKILL.md`. Refuse when the folder already exists in that layer. Validate `name` (one path component, no `..`, no `/`) and the frontmatter with `SkillValidator` before the write.
+- `edit(name:path:content:layer:)`: writes `SKILL.md` or a file of the skill. The path must stay inside `<root>/<name>/` (use the same path rules as `ReadResource`). When the skill is only in a read-only layer (`.defaults` or `.marketplace`), `edit` in the target layer makes an override copy is NOT done: refuse with a corrective that names the read-only layer. Decide and document this one rule in the doc comment.
+- `remove(name:layer:)`: deletes `<root>/<name>/`. Refuse when the folder is not in that layer.
+- A layer that the registry does not have (for example a registry from `init(roots:)`, where each root is `.project`, has no `.user` layer) gives a corrective, not a crash.
+- After each successful write, call `registry.reload()` (SK-6a).
+- No gate (D78, D87).
+- A registry from `init(roots:)` labels each root `.project` (`untrustedLayers(for:)`). Document this in the doc comment.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `add` makes the folder and `SKILL.md` in the user layer by default, and in the project layer with `.project`.
+- [ ] `edit` and `remove` change only the chosen layer. A built-in or marketplace layer is never written.
+- [ ] A bad name, a path out of the skill folder, or a missing layer gives a corrective and writes nothing.
+- [ ] After each write, `registry.metadata()` shows the change, and one `onReload` value arrives.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/SkillWriterTests.swift` with `LayerFixtureSupport`: a stack with defaults, user and project layers in temp folders. One test for each operation and each layer, one for each refusal, and one that the defaults folder is unchanged after each operation.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes with no warnings.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #step1
\ No newline at end of file
